summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for creating reusable AI agent teams, orchestrating multi-model tasks in conversation workflows, and reviewing execution outcomes in a run center.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness web plugin for orchestrating reusable multi-model agent teams rather than code generation or generic utilities. Evidence in README and package metadata shows its core flow is team/member definition, DAG-based or fixed-order execution, conversation mode selection, and run monitoring via a Run Center, which are all workflow-management features. It also adds recipe/version backup-import tooling and provider token insights to support operational control of those runs. It is tightly coupled to DSH host/client services and does not present standalone unrelated plugin capabilities.
